documents.text: Greg Boyer (water polo) Gregory Vaitl "Greg" Boyer (born February 5, 1958) is a former American water polo player who was a member of the United States men's national water polo team and won a silver medal at the 1988 Summer Olympics in Seoul, South Korea. Boyer grew up in New York City and played water polo at Aviation High School. He attended the University of California, Santa Barbara where he played on the Gauchos men's water polo team from 1976–1979. He was a three-time All-American, being named to the first team in 1979. The Gauchos won the 1979 NCAA
